text.en: Clients highlight exceptional handling for both dogs and small pets, including rabbits and guinea pigs. Reviewers note that nervous rescue dogs gain notable confidence on walks, while boarding bunnies return home clean, relaxed, and cheerful. Animals clearly enjoy their stays and daily routines in a safe, pet-focused home setting.

Pet owners describe Kim as dependable, professional, and genuinely invested in the wellbeing of every animal in her care. Multiple clients who have booked dog walking or small pet boarding for years express complete peace of mind. Her patience with anxious or previously injured rescues receives consistent praise from local owners.

Owners consistently appreciate the regular updates, pictures, and video clips sent while their pets are boarding or out walking. Reviewers note that seeing their rabbits exploring the garden or guinea pigs settled comfortably alleviates separation anxiety. Communication is praised as prompt, reassuring, and accommodating at all times.

q.en: Does Kim board small pets like rabbits and guinea pigs?

a.en: Yes, clients frequently praise her dedicated home boarding service for rabbits and guinea pigs.

q.en: Are owners sent updates during pet boarding?

a.en: Yes, reviewers note receiving frequent photo and video updates showing pets active and settled.

q.en: Does she provide private dog walks for nervous rescues?

a.en: Yes, private one-on-one walks are available for dogs that need extra patience or cannot walk in groups.

q.en: Are the pet care services fully insured?

a.en: Yes, K9 Kim operates as a registered business with full commercial insurance coverage.
